about: The twelve known security gaps this study asks of the code their fixes changed. Each fix is a merge (its first parent is the vulnerable side) or a lone commit (its parent is). resolve.py pins them in pins.json.

gaps.class: credential-name crosses into the sandbox by env prefix
tree-rewrite gate judged by policy, not by the directory the verb runs in
liveness evidence (worker heartbeats) writable from inside a task
governance register written with the process umask (group-writable)
apply takes file paths from the signed record it is applying (redirect)
gaps.note: same fix commit as KG06; scored on the one file its finding names, trust_owner_verbs.py (operator 2026-10-28); gap record written 14 minutes before fix 1dbe8f2, from Loki A28BD892

gaps.class: the judged seat chooses the repo whose pin judges it
gaps.note: same fix commit as KG05; scored on the one file its finding names, ci_lint_pin.py (operator 2026-10-28); gap record written 7 minutes before fix 1dbe8f2, from Loki D9E5EF53

gaps.class: allow_localhost shared the host network namespace: full internet, no lease
gaps.note: the gap was opened by an earlier fix (sealed 9fe5e179 exempted allow_localhost from the lease); phase 3 should find that introducing commit; writers were given Loki 7173C72A U1's text; gap 582b1e676fb3 records the exemption that caused it

gaps.class: process argv read as a repo filter, emptying the open-PR set a guard trusts
a file name with U+2028/2029/0085 cut the record on read and bricked the box
unprivileged run inherited root's proxy, CA path and token env
two writers could link to the same tail and fork the hash chain

gaps.source: commit d6b168a, W4 audit findings S4 and B2 (no gap record)
gaps.class: the seat's scrub let key-shaped strings (bare hex, base64 runs, key=/token= fields) and a model's ESCALATE reason reach the screen
gaps.note: d6b168a also carries Q2 and N8, which are not security; only the S4 and B2 files count as the fix, chosen before any run

evidence_weight.strong: source_kind gap_record or audit_finding: the gap's text was written by whoever found it, before the fix
evidence_weight.weaker: source_kind commit_message (KG09, KG10, KG11, KG12): the only text is the fixer's own, written with the fix in hand, like php2shell's NEWS entries; reported apart from the strong set in every table
evidence_weight.ruled: operator 2026-10-28: 'keep KG09-11 marked weaker'; 'take d6b168a as 12th'
